engagement models

Three ways to work with us

Exact numbers depend on scope — this page is about the shape of the engagement, not a locked price list. We'll give you real numbers after the discovery call.

Fixed scope

Project-based

Best for a defined deliverable — a new site, a specific feature, a migration — with a clear start and finish.

  • Fixed price, agreed upfront
  • Defined milestones & timeline
  • Ideal for one-time builds
Retainer

Ongoing partnership

Best when you need continuous work across build, marketing, and support — this is where the dedicated-assistant model lives.

  • Monthly commitment, predictable cost
  • Dedicated point of contact included
  • Covers small requests without new quotes
Staff augmentation

Embedded support

Best when you have internal teams but need specialized capacity — ServiceNow expertise, for example — folded into your existing process.

  • Works inside your existing workflow
  • Scoped by hours or by role
  • Flexible ramp up or down
$

No surprise invoices.

Whichever model fits, scope boundaries are agreed upfront. If a request grows beyond what's covered, we flag it clearly before any additional cost — never after.

Not sure which model fits?

Tell us about the project and we'll recommend the right structure — no pressure to commit to more than you need.
